text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Seeking knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim, and the one who imparts knowledge to those who do not worthy of it is like one who puts a necklace of jewels, pearls, and gold on pigs."
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The best of charity is when a Muslim man gains knowledge, then teaches it to his Muslim brother.'"
The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Richness does not lie in many possessions, but true richness is the richness of the soul."

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If you were to rely upon Allah with the reliance He is due, He would provide for you just as He provides for the birds; they go out hungry in the morning and return full in the evening."
